name: Huffman Entropy Coder
description: PHF Huffman entropy coder (T = u8/u16/u32). Lossless. Two encode paths: Coarse (multi-kernel, CPU prefix-sum sync) and Fine (single-kernel, fully GPU-async). Byte-transparent output.

config.name: bklen
config.description: Codebook length (distinct symbols). Default 256 for u8, 1024 for u16/u32. Must be <= 2^(8*sizeof(T)).

config.name: encodeMode
config.description: Coarse = stable multi-kernel path with CPU sync. Fine = ReVISIT-lite single kernel, no mid-encode CPU sync.

paper.title: cuSZ: An Error-Bounded Lossy Compressor for GPU Scientific Data
